On prêtait au pape Gerbert d'Aurillac un: Pope Gerbert of Aurillac was said to own a bronze head that answered any question with yes or no. A binary oracle, a thousand years before computing. It predicted he would not die before saying Mass in Jerusalem. He said it in Rome, in the church of Santa Croce in Gerusalemme, and died shortly after. Accurate, but not very helpful.
Elle répond par oui ou par non : quiz de: It answers yes or no: 4-question quizzes, but a failed recall moves you back twice as far.
